nodes.name: outln
nodes.body_text: macro_rules! outln { ($($arg:tt)*) => {{ use std::io::Write as _; if let Err(e) = writeln!(std::io::stdout(), $($arg)*) { $crate::stdout_failed(e); } }}; }

nodes.name: USAGE
nodes.body_text: const USAGE: &str = "usage: lattice-cli info <file> [--json] sheets, used ranges, tables, charts, names lattice-cli convert <in> <out> [--sheet NAME] xlsx/csv/tsv/json/html by extension lattice-cli eval <formula> [--in FILE] [--sheet S] [--cell A1] [--json] lattice-cli cat <file> [--range A1:D20] [--sheet S] [--formulas] [--csv] lattice-cli run [--in FILE | --sample NAME] [--cmd 'id={json}']... [--script FILE.jsonl] [--out FILE] [--print RANGE] [--quiet] lattice-cli commands [--json] [--search X] lattice-cli functions [--json] [--search X] [--category C] lattice-cli mcp [--connect PORT] [--in FILE | --sample NAME] lattice-cli send <port> <method> [json] lattice-cli version";

nodes.name: stdout_failed
nodes.body_text: fn stdout_failed(e: std::io::Error) -> ! { if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe { std::process::exit(0); } eprintln!("lattice-cli: can't write to stdout: {e}"); std::process::exit(1); }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: fn main() -> ExitCode { let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect(); let rest = args.get(1..).unwrap_or_default(); let r = match args.first().map(String::as_str) { Some("--version" | "-V" | "version") => { outln!("lattice-cli {}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")); Ok(()) } Some("--help" | "-h" | "help") => { outln!("{USAGE}"); Ok(()) } Some("info") => info(rest), Some("convert") => convert(rest), Some("eval") => eval(rest), Some("cat") => cat(rest), Some("run") => run(rest), Some("commands") => commands(rest), Some("functions") => functions(rest), Some("mcp") => mcp(rest), Some("send") => send(rest), Some(other) => Err(format!("unknown subcommand `{other}`\n{USAGE}")), None => Err(USAGE.to_string()), }; match r { Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS, Err(e) => { eprintln!("lattice-cli: {e}"); ExitCode::FAILURE } } }

nodes.name: Args
nodes.body_text: struct Args { positional: Vec<String>, opts: Vec<(String, String)>, switches: Vec<String>, }

nodes.name: parse
nodes.signature: fn parse(args: &[String], with_value: &[&str], switches: &[&str]) -> Result<Args, String>
nodes.body_text: fn parse(args: &[String], with_value: &[&str], switches: &[&str]) -> Result<Args, String> { let mut out = Args { positional: vec![], opts: vec![], switches: vec![] }; let mut it = args.iter(); while let Some(a) = it.next() { if let Some(name) = a.strip_prefix("--").filter(|n| !n.is_empty()) { let (name, inline) = match name.split_once('=') { Some((n, v)) => (n, Some(v.to_string())), None => (name, None), }; if with_value.contains(&name) { let v = match inline { Some(v) => v, None => it.next().cloned().ok_or_else(|| format!("--{name} needs a value"))?, }; out.opts.push((name.to_string(), v)); } else if switches.contains(&name) && inline.is_none() { out.switches.push(name.to_string()); } else { return Err(format!("unknown option --{name}")); } } else { out.positional.push(a.clone()); } } Ok(out) }

nodes.name: opt
nodes.body_text: fn opt(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&str> { self.opts.iter().rev().find(|(n, _)| n == name).map(|(_, v)| v.as_str()) }

nodes.name: has
nodes.body_text: fn has(&self, name: &str) -> bool { self.switches.iter().any(|s| s == name) }

nodes.name: pos
nodes.signature: fn pos(&self, i: usize, what: &str) -> Result<&str, String>
nodes.body_text: fn pos(&self, i: usize, what: &str) -> Result<&str, String> { self.positional.get(i).map(String::as_str).ok_or_else(|| format!("missing {what}\n{USAGE}")) }

nodes.name: no_extra
nodes.signature: fn no_extra(&self, n: usize) -> Result<(), String>
nodes.body_text: fn no_extra(&self, n: usize) -> Result<(), String> { match self.positional.get(n) { Some(x) => Err(format!("unexpected argument `{x}`")), None => Ok(()), } }

nodes.name: exec
nodes.signature: fn exec(s: &mut Session, id: &str, params: Value) -> Result<Value, String>
nodes.body_text: fn exec(s: &mut Session, id: &str, params: Value) -> Result<Value, String> { let r = s.execute_headless(id, params).map_err(|e| e.to_string()); if id == "file.open" && let Ok(value) = &r && let Some(warnings) = value.get("warnings").and_then(Value::as_array) { for warning in warnings.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str) { eprintln!("Warning: {warning}"); } } r }

nodes.name: open
nodes.body_text: fn open(path: &str) -> Result<Session, String> { let mut s = Session::new(); exec(&mut s, "file.open", json!({"path": path}))?; Ok(s) }

nodes.name: blank
nodes.body_text: fn blank() -> Session { let mut s = Session::new(); s.new_workbook(); s }

nodes.name: activate_sheet
nodes.signature: fn activate_sheet(s: &mut Session, sheet: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String>
nodes.body_text: fn activate_sheet(s: &mut Session, sheet: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> { if let Some(name) = sheet { let p = match name.parse::<u64>() { // A number that isn't also a sheet name is an index. Ok(i) if s.doc().is_ok_and(|d| d.wb.sheet_index(name).is_none()) => json!({"sheet": i}), _ => json!({"sheet": name}), }; exec(s, "sheet.activate", p)?; } Ok(()) }

nodes.name: pretty
nodes.body_text: fn pretty(v: &Value) -> String { serde_json::to_string_pretty(v).unwrap_or_default() }

nodes.name: number_text
nodes.body_text: fn number_text(n: f64) -> String { if n.fract() == 0.0 && n.abs() < 1e15 { format!("{}", n as i64) } else { format!("{n}") } }

nodes.name: value_text
nodes.body_text: fn value_text(v: &Value) -> String { match v { Value::Null => String::new(), Value::Bool(b) => if *b { "TRUE" } else { "FALSE" }.to_string(), Value::Number(n) => n.as_f64().map(number_text).unwrap_or_else(|| n.to_string()), Value::String(s) => s.clone(), Value::Object(o) => o.get("error").and_then(Value::as_str).map(str::to_string).unwrap_or_else(|| v.to_string()), Value::Array(rows) => rows .iter() .map(|r| match r { Value::Array(cells) => cells.iter().map(value_text).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\t"), other => value_text(other), }) .collect::<Vec<_>>() .join("\n"), } }

nodes.name: csv_field
nodes.body_text: fn csv_field(s: &str, delim: char) -> String { if s.contains(delim) || s.contains('"') || s.contains('\n') || s.contains('\r') { format!("\"{}\"", s.replace('"', "\"\"")) } else { s.to_string() } }

nodes.name: info
nodes.body_text: fn info(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &[], &["json"])?; let path = a.pos(0, "<file>")?; a.no_extra(1)?; let mut s = open(path)?; let v = exec(&mut s, "document.inspect", json!({}))?; if a.has("json") { outln!("{}", pretty(&v)); return Ok(()); } outln!("{}", v["title"].as_str().unwrap_or(path)); for (i, sh) in v["sheets"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().enumerate() { let active = if v["activeSheet"].as_u64() == Some(i as u64) { "*" } else { " " }; let vis = sh["visibility"].as_str().filter(|x| *x != "Visible").map(|x| format!(" ({x})")).unwrap_or_default(); outln!( "{active} {}{vis}: used {}, {} cells", sh["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), sh["usedRange"].as_str().unwrap_or("(empty)"), sh["cells"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) ); for t in sh["tables"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() { outln!(" table {} {} ({})", t["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), t["range"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), t["style"].as_str().unwrap_or("")); } for c in sh["charts"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() { let title = c["title"].as_str().map(|t| format!(" \"{t}\"")).unwrap_or_default(); outln!(" chart {}{title} at {}, {} series", c["kind"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), c["at"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), c["series"]); } if let Some(f) = sh["autofilter"].as_str() { outln!(" filter {f}"); } } let names = v["names"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default(); if !names.is_empty() { outln!("names:"); for n in names { outln!(" {} {}", n["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), n["refersTo"].as_str().unwrap_or("")); } } Ok(()) }

nodes.name: convert
nodes.body_text: fn convert(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &["sheet"], &[])?; let input = a.pos(0, "<in>")?; let out = a.pos(1, "<out>")?; a.no_extra(2)?; if lattice_engine::io::FileKind::from_path(out).is_none() { return Err(format!("{out}: unknown output format (use .xlsx, .csv, .tsv, .json or .html)")); } let mut s = open(input)?; activate_sheet(&mut s, a.opt("sheet"))?; let d = s.doc().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; let bytes = lattice_engine::io::save_bytes(&d.wb, out).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; lattice_engine::io::write_file(out, &bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; eprintln!("wrote {out} ({} bytes)", bytes.len()); Ok(()) }

nodes.name: eval
nodes.body_text: fn eval(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &["in", "sheet", "cell"], &["json"])?; let formula = a.pos(0, "<formula>")?; a.no_extra(1)?; let mut s = match a.opt("in") { Some(p) => open(p)?, None => blank(), }; activate_sheet(&mut s, a.opt("sheet"))?; let formula = if formula.starts_with('=') { formula.to_string() } else { format!("={formula}") }; let mut p = json!({"formula": formula}); if let Some(c) = a.opt("cell") { p["cell"] = json!(c); } let v = exec(&mut s, "formulas.evaluate", p)?; if a.has("json") { outln!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&v).unwrap_or_default()); } else { outln!("{}", value_text(&v)); } Ok(()) }

nodes.name: print_range
nodes.signature: fn print_range(s: &mut Session, range: Option<&str>, sheet: Option<&str>, formulas: bool, csv: bool) -> Result<(), String>
nodes.body_text: fn print_range(s: &mut Session, range: Option<&str>, sheet: Option<&str>, formulas: bool, csv: bool) -> Result<(), String> { let mut p = json!({}); if let Some(r) = range { p["range"] = json!(r); } if let Some(sh) = sheet { p["sheet"] = json!(sh); } let raw = exec(s, "sheet.read", p.clone())?; p["formatted"] = json!(true); p["formulas"] = json!(formulas); let shown = exec(s, "sheet.read", p)?; let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = shown["values"] .as_array() .into_iter() .flatten() .map(|r| r.as_array().into_iter().flatten().map(|c| c.as_str().map(str::to_string).unwrap_or_else(|| value_text(c))).collect()) .collect(); if csv { for r in &rows { outln!("{}", r.iter().map(|c| csv_field(c, ',')).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")); } return Ok(()); } let numeric = |ri: usize, ci: usize| raw["values"][ri][ci].is_number() && !formulas; let ncols = rows.iter().map(Vec::len).max().unwrap_or(0); let widths: Vec<usize> = (0..ncols).map(|c| rows.iter().filter_map(|r| r.get(c)).map(|t| t.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(60)).collect(); for (ri, r) in rows.iter().enumerate() { let mut line = String::new(); for (ci, cell) in r.iter().enumerate() { let w = widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(0); let cell: String = cell.chars().map(|c| if c == '\n' || c == '\t' { ' ' } else { c }).collect(); if ci > 0 { line.push_str(" "); } if numeric(ri, ci) { line.push_str(&format!("{cell:>w$}")); } else { line.push_str(&format!("{cell:<w$}")); } } outln!("{}", line.trim_end()); } Ok(()) }

nodes.name: cat
nodes.body_text: fn cat(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &["range", "sheet"], &["formulas", "csv"])?; let path = a.pos(0, "<file>")?; a.no_extra(1)?; let mut s = open(path)?; print_range(&mut s, a.opt("range"), a.opt("sheet"), a.has("formulas"), a.has("csv")) }

nodes.name: parse_command
nodes.body_text: fn parse_command(text: &str) -> Result<Option<(String, Value)>, String> { let t = text.trim(); if t.is_empty() || t.starts_with('#') || t.starts_with("//") { return Ok(None); } if t.starts_with('{') { let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(t).map_err(|e| format!("bad JSON: {e}"))?; let id = v.get("command").or_else(|| v.get("id")).and_then(Value::as_str).ok_or("JSON command needs a `command` field")?; return Ok(Some((id.to_string(), v.get("params").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| json!({}))))); } let split = t.find(['=', ' ', '\t']); let (id, rest) = match split { Some(i) => (t.get(..i).unwrap_or(t), t.get(i + 1..).unwrap_or("").trim()), None => (t, ""), }; let params = if rest.is_empty() { json!({}) } else { serde_json::from_str(rest).map_err(|e| format!("{id}: bad JSON params: {e}"))? }; Ok(Some((id.to_string(), params))) }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: fn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &["in", "sample", "cmd", "script", "out", "print", "sheet"], &["quiet", "csv", "formulas"])?; a.no_extra(0)?; let mut s = match (a.opt("in"), a.opt("sample")) { (Some(_), Some(_)) => return Err("give --in or --sample, not both".into()), (Some(p), None) => open(p)?, (None, Some(name)) => { let mut s = Session::new(); exec(&mut s, "file.new", json!({"sample": name}))?; s } (None, None) => blank(), }; let quiet = a.has("quiet"); let mut step = 0usize; for (name, value) in &a.opts { let cmds: Vec<(String, Value, String)> = match name.as_str() { "cmd" => parse_command(value)?.map(|(id, p)| vec![(id, p, "--cmd".to_string())]).unwrap_or_default(), "script" => { let text = std::fs::read_to_string(value).map_err(|e| format!("{value}: {e}"))?; let mut v = Vec::new(); for (i, line) in text.lines().enumerate() { if let Some((id, p)) = parse_command(line).map_err(|e| format!("{value}:{}: {e}", i + 1))? { v.push((id, p, format!("{value}:{}", i + 1))); } } v } _ => continue, }; for (id, p, origin) in cmds { step += 1; let r = exec(&mut s, &id, p).map_err(|e| format!("step {step} ({origin}, {id}): {e}"))?; if !quiet && !r.is_null() { outln!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&json!({"command": id, "result": r})).unwrap_or_default()); } } } if let Some(out) = a.opt("out") { let r = exec(&mut s, "file.save", json!({"path": out}))?; eprintln!("wrote {out} ({} bytes)", r["bytes"]); } for (name, range) in &a.opts { if name == "print" { let range = if range.is_empty() || range == "used" { None } else { Some(range.as_str()) }; print_range(&mut s, range, a.opt("sheet"), a.has("formulas"), a.has("csv"))?; } } Ok(()) }

nodes.name: commands
nodes.body_text: fn commands(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &["search"], &["json"])?; let q = a.opt("search").or(a.positional.first().map(String::as_str)).map(str::to_ascii_lowercase); let s = Session::new(); let list: Vec<_> = s .commands() .into_iter() .filter(|c| { q.as_ref().is_none_or(|q| { c.id.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(q.as_str()) || c.label.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(q.as_str()) || c.menu.iter().any(|m| m.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(q.as_str())) }) }) .collect(); if a.has("json") { // Enablement depends on a live workbook; not meaningful here. let v: Vec<Value> = list.iter().map(|c| json!({"id": c.id, "label": c.label, "menu": c.menu, "shortcut": c.shortcut, "params": c.params})).collect(); outln!("{}", pretty(&Value::Array(v))); return Ok(()); } let w = list.iter().map(|c| c.id.len()).max().unwrap_or(0); for c in &list { let sc = c.shortcut.map(|s| format!(" [{s}]")).unwrap_or_default(); let menu = if c.menu.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(" ({})", c.menu.join(" > ")) }; outln!("{:<w$} {}{menu}{sc}", c.id, c.label.trim_end_matches('…')); outln!("{:<w$} {}", "", c.params); } eprintln!("{} commands", list.len()); Ok(()) }

nodes.name: functions
nodes.body_text: fn functions(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { let a = Args::parse(args, &["search", "category"], &["json"])?; let mut p = json!({}); if let Some(q) = a.opt("search").or(a.positional.first().map(String::as_str)) { p["search"] = json!(q); } if let Some(c) = a.opt("category") { p["category"] = json!(c); } let mut s = Session::new(); let v = exec(&mut s, "formulas.functions", p)?; if a.has("json") { outln!("{}", pretty(&v)); return Ok(()); } let list = v.as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default(); for f in &list { let sig = f["signature"].as_str().or(f["name"].as_str()).unwrap_or("?"); outln!("{sig}"); let cat = f["category"].as_str().unwrap_or(""); let desc = f["description"].as_str().unwrap_or(""); outln!(" {cat}: {desc}"); } eprintln!("{} functions", list.len()); Ok(()) }

nodes.name: mcp
nodes.body_text: fn mcp(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { use lattice_mcp::{Backend, Headless, Remote, Server, control_addr}; let a = Args::parse(args, &["connect", "in", "sample"], &[])?; a.no_extra(0)?; let backend: Box<dyn Backend> = match a.opt("connect") { Some(c) => { let addr = control_addr(c); Box::new( Remote::connect(&addr) .map_err(|e| format!("cannot connect to the Lattice app at {addr}: {e} (start it with `lattice --control PORT`)"))?, ) } None => { let session = match (a.opt("in"), a.opt("sample")) { (Some(p), _) => open(p)?, (None, Some(name)) => { let mut s = Session::new(); exec(&mut s, "file.new", json!({"sample": name}))?; s } (None, None) => blank(), }; Box::new(Headless::with_session(session)) } }; eprintln!("lattice-cli: MCP server on stdio ({})", backend.describe()); let stdin = std::io::stdin(); let stdout = std::io::stdout(); Server::new(backend).serve(stdin.lock(), stdout.lock()).map_err(|e| e.to_string()) }

nodes.name: send
nodes.body_text: fn send(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> { use lattice_mcp::{Backend, Remote, control_addr}; let port = args.first().ok_or_else(|| format!("missing <port>\n{USAGE}"))?; let method = args.get(1).ok_or_else(|| format!("missing <method>\n{USAGE}"))?; let params: Value = match args.get(2) { Some(t) => serde_json::from_str(t).map_err(|e| format!("bad JSON params: {e}"))?, None => json!({}), }; if let Some(x) = args.get(3) { return Err(format!("unexpected argument `{x}`")); } let addr = control_addr(port); let mut r = Remote::connect(&addr).map_err(|e| format!("cannot connect to the Lattice app at {addr}: {e} (start it with `lattice --control {port}`)"))?; let v = r.call(method, params)?; outln!("{}", pretty(&v)); Ok(()) }

nodes.name: tests
nodes.body_text: mod tests { #![allow(clippy::unwrap_used)] use super::*; #[test] fn parses_commands() { assert_eq!(parse_command("home.bold={\"range\":\"A1\"}").unwrap(), Some(("home.bold".into(), json!({"range": "A1"})))); assert_eq!(parse_command("edit.undo").unwrap(), Some(("edit.undo".into(), json!({})))); assert_eq!( parse_command("cell.set {\"cell\":\"A1\",\"input\":\"=1\"}").unwrap(), Some(("cell.set".into(), json!({"cell": "A1", "input": "=1"}))) ); assert_eq!(parse_command("{\"command\":\"edit.redo\"}").unwrap(), Some(("edit.redo".into(), json!({})))); assert_eq!(parse_command(" # comment").unwrap(), None); assert!(parse_command("x={bad").is_err()); } #[test] fn value_texts() { assert_eq!(value_text(&json!(6.0)), "6"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!(0.25)), "0.25"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!(true)), "TRUE"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!({"error": "#DIV/0!"})), "#DIV/0!"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, "x"]])), "1\t2\n3\tx"); } #[test] fn args_parsing() { let v: Vec<String> = ["a", "--range", "A1", "--csv", "--sheet=S"].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(); let a = Args::parse(&v, &["range", "sheet"], &["csv"]).unwrap(); assert_eq!(a.positional, ["a"]); assert_eq!(a.opt("range"), Some("A1")); assert_eq!(a.opt("sheet"), Some("S")); assert!(a.has("csv")); assert!(Args::parse(&["--nope".to_string()], &[], &[]).is_err()); assert!(Args::parse(&["--range".to_string()], &["range"], &[]).is_err()); } }

nodes.name: parses_commands
nodes.body_text: fn parses_commands() { assert_eq!(parse_command("home.bold={\"range\":\"A1\"}").unwrap(), Some(("home.bold".into(), json!({"range": "A1"})))); assert_eq!(parse_command("edit.undo").unwrap(), Some(("edit.undo".into(), json!({})))); assert_eq!( parse_command("cell.set {\"cell\":\"A1\",\"input\":\"=1\"}").unwrap(), Some(("cell.set".into(), json!({"cell": "A1", "input": "=1"}))) ); assert_eq!(parse_command("{\"command\":\"edit.redo\"}").unwrap(), Some(("edit.redo".into(), json!({})))); assert_eq!(parse_command(" # comment").unwrap(), None); assert!(parse_command("x={bad").is_err()); }

nodes.name: value_texts
nodes.body_text: fn value_texts() { assert_eq!(value_text(&json!(6.0)), "6"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!(0.25)), "0.25"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!(true)), "TRUE"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!({"error": "#DIV/0!"})), "#DIV/0!"); assert_eq!(value_text(&json!([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, "x"]])), "1\t2\n3\tx"); }

nodes.name: args_parsing
nodes.body_text: fn args_parsing() { let v: Vec<String> = ["a", "--range", "A1", "--csv", "--sheet=S"].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(); let a = Args::parse(&v, &["range", "sheet"], &["csv"]).unwrap(); assert_eq!(a.positional, ["a"]); assert_eq!(a.opt("range"), Some("A1")); assert_eq!(a.opt("sheet"), Some("S")); assert!(a.has("csv")); assert!(Args::parse(&["--nope".to_string()], &[], &[]).is_err()); assert!(Args::parse(&["--range".to_string()], &["range"], &[]).is_err()); }

nodes.name: bin
nodes.body_text: fn bin() -> Command { Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_lattice-cli")) }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: fn run(args: &[&str]) -> Output { bin().args(args).output().expect("run lattice-cli") }

nodes.name: ok
nodes.body_text: fn ok(args: &[&str]) -> String { let o = run(args); assert!(o.status.success(), "lattice-cli {args:?} failed: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stderr)); String::from_utf8(o.stdout).unwrap() }

nodes.name: tmpdir
nodes.body_text: fn tmpdir(name: &str) -> PathBuf { let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("lattice-cli-test-{}-{name}", std::process::id())); std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap(); d }

nodes.name: version_and_usage

nodes.name: copy_html
nodes.body_text: fn copy_html(html: &str, text: &str) -> Result<(), String> { let js = |e: wasm_bindgen::JsValue| format!("{e:?}"); let window = web_sys::window().ok_or("no window")?; let clipboard = window.navigator().clipboard(); if clipboard.is_undefined() || clipboard.is_null() { return Err("browser clipboard is unavailable (a secure context is required)".into()); } if !js_sys::Reflect::get(&clipboard, &"write".into()).map_err(js)?.is_function() { return Err("browser does not support rich clipboard writes".into()); } let data = js_sys::Object::new(); for (mime, value) in [("text/html", html), ("text/plain", text)] { let opts = web_sys::BlobPropertyBag::new(); opts.set_type(mime); let parts = js_sys::Array::of1(&wasm_bindgen::JsValue::from_str(value)); let blob = web_sys::Blob::new_with_str_sequence_and_options(&parts, &opts).map_err(js)?; js_sys::Reflect::set(&data, &mime.into(), &blob).map_err(js)?; } let item = web_sys::ClipboardItem::new_with_record_from_str_to_blob_promise(&data).map_err(js)?; let promise = clipboard.write(&js_sys::Array::of1(&item)); let text = text.to_owned(); wasm_bindgen_futures::spawn_local(async move { if let Err(e) = wasm_bindgen_futures::JsFuture::from(promise).await { log::warn!("Rich clipboard write failed; trying plain text: {e:?}"); if let Err(e) = wasm_bindgen_futures::JsFuture::from(clipboard.write_text(&text)).await { log::error!("Plain-text clipboard fallback also failed: {e:?}"); } } }); Ok(()) }

nodes.body_text: fn download(name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> { let js = |e: wasm_bindgen::JsValue| format!("{e:?}"); let window = web_sys::window().ok_or("no window")?; let document = window.document().ok_or("no document")?; let parts = js_sys::Array::of1(&js_sys::Uint8Array::from(bytes)); let opts = web_sys::BlobPropertyBag::new(); opts.set_type(if name.ends_with(".csv") { "text/csv" } else { "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" }); let blob = web_sys::Blob::new_with_u8_array_sequence_and_options(&parts, &opts).map_err(js)?; let url = web_sys::Url::create_object_url_with_blob(&blob).map_err(js)?; let a: web_sys::HtmlAnchorElement = document.create_element("a").map_err(js)?.dyn_into().map_err(|_| "not an anchor")?; a.set_href(&url); a.set_download(name); a.style().set_property("display", "none").map_err(js)?; let body = document.body().ok_or("no body")?; body.append_child(&a).map_err(js)?; a.click(); a.remove(); let revoke = wasm_bindgen::closure::Closure::once_into_js(move || { web_sys::Url::revoke_object_url(&url).ok(); }); window.set_timeout_with_callback_and_timeout_and_arguments_0(revoke.unchecked_ref(), 10_000).map_err(js)?; Ok(()) }

nodes.signature: pub fn start(port: u16, ctx: egui::Context) -> std::io::Result<Receiver<ControlRequest>>
nodes.body_text: pub fn start(port: u16, ctx: egui::Context) -> std::io::Result<Receiver<ControlRequest>> { let listener = TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port))?; let (tx, rx) = channel(); std::thread::Builder::new().name("control".into()).spawn(move || { for stream in listener.incoming().flatten() { let tx = tx.clone(); let ctx = ctx.clone(); let _ = std::thread::Builder::new().name("control-conn".into()).spawn(move || serve(stream, tx, ctx)); } })?; log::info!("control channel listening on 127.0.0.1:{port}"); Ok(rx) }

nodes.name: serve
nodes.signature: fn serve(stream: TcpStream, tx: Sender<ControlRequest>, ctx: egui::Context)
nodes.body_text: fn serve(stream: TcpStream, tx: Sender<ControlRequest>, ctx: egui::Context) { let Ok(read) = stream.try_clone() else { return }; let mut out = stream; let reader = BufReader::new(read); for line in reader.lines() { let Ok(line) = line else { break }; if line.trim().is_empty() { continue; } if line.len() > MAX_LINE { let _ = writeln!(out, "{}", json!({"ok": false, "error": "request too large"})); continue; } let msg: Json = match serde_json::from_str(&line) { Ok(v) => v, Err(e) => { let _ = writeln!(out, "{}", json!({"ok": false, "error": format!("invalid JSON: {e}")})); continue; } }; let id = msg.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Json::Null); let method = msg.get("method").and_then(Json::as_str).unwrap_or("").to_string(); let params = msg.get("params").cloned().unwrap_or(json!({})); let (req, rx) = ControlRequest::new(method, params); if tx.send(req).is_err() { break; } // Wake the UI thread: egui only runs frames when something happens. ctx.request_repaint(); let mut reply = rx .recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60)) .unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({"ok": false, "error": "timed out waiting for the UI (is the window minimised?)"})); if let Some(o) = reply.as_object_mut() { o.insert("id".into(), id); } if writeln!(out, "{reply}").is_err() { break; } } }

nodes.name: configure
nodes.signature: pub fn configure(options: &mut NativeOptions, backend_override: Option<Backends>)
nodes.body_text: pub fn configure(options: &mut NativeOptions, backend_override: Option<Backends>) { if let WgpuSetup::CreateNew(create) = &mut options.wgpu_options.wgpu_setup { // eframe's default includes GL. Creating that backend can crash inside AMD's // atio6axx.dll before adapter selection or any Rust error handling runs, so the // window never appears. Choosing an adapter afterwards is too late: only leaving GL // out of the instance avoids it. This matches the verified WGPU_BACKEND=dx12 // workaround without mutating process environment variables. create.instance_descriptor.backends = backend_override.unwrap_or(Backends::DX12); } }

nodes.name: parse
nodes.body_text: pub fn parse(spec: &str) -> Filter { let mut f = Filter { default: LevelFilter::Error, directives: Vec::new() }; for part in spec.split(',').map(str::trim).filter(|p| !p.is_empty()) { match part.split_once('=') { Some((name, level)) => { let name = name.trim(); if let (false, Some(level)) = (name.is_empty(), parse_level(level)) { f.directives.push((name.to_owned(), level)); } } None => match parse_level(part) { Some(level) => f.default = level, // A bare target name: everything from it (env_logger does the same). None => f.directives.push((part.to_owned(), LevelFilter::Trace)), }, } } f }

nodes.body_text: pub fn timestamp(t: SystemTime) -> String { let since = t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default(); let secs = since.as_secs(); let (days, rem) = (secs / 86_400, secs % 86_400); let (y, m, d) = civil_from_days(days); format!("{y:04}-{m:02}-{d:02}T{:02}:{:02}:{:02}.{:03}Z", rem / 3600, rem % 3600 / 60, rem % 60, since.subsec_millis()) }

nodes.name: civil_from_days
nodes.body_text: fn civil_from_days(days: u64) -> (u64, u64, u64) { let z = days.saturating_add(719_468); let era = z / 146_097; let doe = z % 146_097; let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36_524 - doe / 146_096) / 365; let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100); let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153; let d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1; let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 }; let y = era.saturating_mul(400).saturating_add(yoe).saturating_add(u64::from(m <= 2)); (y, m, d) }

nodes.body_text: pub fn write(&mut self, line: &str) { if self.file.is_none() { if self.capped { // No file is coming ([`Sink::no_file`]): standard error had the line. } else if self.pending.len() < MAX_PENDING { self.pending.push(line.to_owned()); } else { self.dropped = self.dropped.saturating_add(1); } return; } self.append(line); }

nodes.name: attach
nodes.signature: pub fn attach(&mut self, file: File)
nodes.body_text: pub fn attach(&mut self, file: File) { self.file = Some(file); self.written = 0; self.capped = false; for line in std::mem::take(&mut self.pending) { self.append(&line); } if self.dropped > 0 { let note = format!("{} earlier log lines were dropped before the log file was opened\n", self.dropped); self.dropped = 0; self.append(&note); } }

nodes.name: no_file
nodes.body_text: pub fn no_file(&mut self) { self.pending = Vec::new(); self.dropped = 0; self.capped = true; }

nodes.name: append
nodes.body_text: fn append(&mut self, line: &str) { if self.capped { return; } let Some(file) = self.file.as_mut() else { return }; let len = u64::try_from(line.len()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX); let text = if self.written.saturating_add(len) > self.max_bytes { self.capped = true; format!("log file reached {} bytes; later records go to standard error only\n", self.max_bytes) } else { self.written = self.written.saturating_add(len); line.to_owned() }; // A full disk or a vanished file must not take the app down: drop the file sink. if file.write_all(text.as_bytes()).is_err() { self.file = None; self.capped = true; } }

nodes.name: AppLogger
nodes.body_text: pub struct AppLogger { filter: Filter, stderr: bool, sink: Mutex<Sink>, }

nodes.name: new
nodes.signature: pub fn new(filter: Filter, stderr: bool) -> AppLogger
nodes.body_text: pub fn new(filter: Filter, stderr: bool) -> AppLogger { AppLogger { filter, stderr, sink: Mutex::new(Sink::new(MAX_FILE_BYTES)) } }

nodes.name: attach_dir
nodes.signature: pub fn attach_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String>
nodes.body_text: pub fn attach_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> { // A thread that panicked while logging leaves the sink usable: take it back. let mut sink = self.sink.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner); match rotate(dir) { Ok((path, file)) => { sink.attach(file); Ok(path) } Err(e) => { sink.no_file(); Err(format!("{}: {e}", dir.display())) } } }

nodes.name: no_file
nodes.body_text: pub fn no_file(&self) { self.sink.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner).no_file(); }

nodes.name: enabled
nodes.body_text: fn enabled(&self, metadata: &log::Metadata<'_>) -> bool { metadata.level() <= self.filter.level_for(metadata.target()) }

nodes.name: log
nodes.body_text: fn log(&self, record: &log::Record<'_>) { if !self.enabled(record.metadata()) { return; } // Formatted before the sink is locked, so a message that logs while it is formatted can't deadlock. let thread = std::thread::current(); #[allow(clippy::disallowed_methods)] // the desktop app (native only): wasm never runs it let line = format_line(&timestamp(SystemTime::now()), record.level(), thread.name().unwrap_or("?"), record.target(), &record.args().to_string()); if self.stderr { // No terminal (a Windows GUI build, a closed pipe) is not an error worth reporting. let _ = std::io::stderr().write_all(line.as_bytes()); } self.sink.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner).write(&line); }

nodes.name: install
nodes.body_text: pub fn install() -> Option<&'static AppLogger> { static LOGGER: OnceLock<AppLogger> = OnceLock::new(); let spec = std::env::var("RUST_LOG").ok().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()); let filter = Filter::parse(spec.as_deref().unwrap_or(DEFAULT_FILTER)); let max = filter.max(); let logger = LOGGER.get_or_init(|| AppLogger::new(filter, true)); log::set_logger(logger).ok()?; log::set_max_level(max); Some(logger) }

nodes.body_text: fn load_prefs(app: &mut SheetApp) { if !prefs_enabled() { return; } // First run (or a ui.json without a usable language): follow the desktop's language. app.ui.language = lattice_ui_egui::i18n::Language::system(); let Some(dir) = config_dir() else { return }; if let Ok(b) = std::fs::read(dir.join("ui.json")) && let Ok(ui) = serde_json::from_slice::<lattice_ui_egui::UiState>(&b) { let saved = serde_json::from_slice(&b).ok().and_then(|v| lattice_ui_egui::i18n::saved_language(&v)); let language = saved.unwrap_or(app.ui.language); app.ui = ui; app.ui.language = language; } if let Ok(b) = std::fs::read(dir.join("prefs.json")) && let Ok(p) = serde_json::from_slice(&b) { app.session.prefs = p; } }

nodes.name: save_prefs
nodes.body_text: fn save_prefs(app: &SheetApp) { if !prefs_enabled() { return; } let Some(dir) = config_dir() else { return }; let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir); if let Ok(b) = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&app.ui) { let _ = std::fs::write(dir.join("ui.json"), b); } if let Ok(b) = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&app.session.prefs) { let _ = std::fs::write(dir.join("prefs.json"), b); } }

nodes.name: services
nodes.body_text: fn services() -> Services { // Keep the owner alive: X11/Wayland serve clipboard data from this handle. let mut clipboard: Option<arboard::Clipboard> = None; Services { copy_html: Some(Box::new(move |html, text| { if clipboard.is_none() { clipboard = Some(arboard::Clipboard::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?); } clipboard.as_mut().ok_or("clipboard unavailable")?.set_html(html, Some(text)).map_err(|e| e.to_string()) })), pick_open: Some(Box::new(|| { rfd::FileDialog::new() .add_filter("Spreadsheets", &["xlsx", "xlsm", "xlsb", "ods", "csv", "tsv", "txt", "json"]) .add_filter("Excel Workbook", &["xlsx", "xlsm"]) .add_filter("Excel Binary Workbook (data import)", &["xlsb"]) .add_filter("OpenDocument Spreadsheet (data import)", &["ods"]) .add_filter("CSV", &["csv"]) .pick_file() .and_then(|p| p.to_str().map(str::to_string)) })), pick_picture: Some(Box::new(|| { rfd::FileDialog::new() .add_filter("Pictures (PNG, JPEG)", &["png", "jpg", "jpeg"]) .pick_file() .and_then(|p| p.to_str().map(str::to_string)) })), pick_save: Some(Box::new(|suggested: &str| { let stem = std::path::Path::new(suggested).file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("Book1").to_string(); rfd::FileDialog::new() .set_file_name(format!("{stem}.xlsx")) .add_filter("Excel Workbook (.xlsx)", &["xlsx"]) .add_filter("CSV UTF-8 (.csv)", &["csv"]) .add_filter("Web Page (.html)", &["html"]) .save_file() .and_then(|p| p.to_str().map(str::to_string)) })), open_url: Some(Box::new(|url: &str| { let cmd = if cfg!(target_os = "macos") { "open" } else if cfg!(windows) { "explorer" } else { "xdg-open" }; let _ = std::process::Command::new(cmd).arg(url).spawn(); })), ..Default::default() } }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> { // First, so the panic hook and every start-up warning are recorded (`logging`). let logger = logging::install(); // Commands catch their panics (`Session::execute`), but the default hook only prints to // standard error; this one sends every panic, caught or not, to the log file too, with a // backtrace when RUST_BACKTRACE is set. std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|info| { let trace = std::backtrace::Backtrace::capture(); let report = if trace.status() == std::backtrace::BacktraceStatus::Captured { format!("internal error: {info}\n{trace}") } else { format!("internal error: {info}") }; // Standard error and the log file; standard error alone when RUST_LOG turned errors off. if log::log_enabled!(log::Level::Error) { log::error!("{report}"); } else { // `eprintln!` panics on a broken stderr pipe, and a panic inside the panic hook aborts. let _ = std::io::Write::write_fmt(&mut std::io::stderr(), format_args!("lattice: {report}\n")); } })); let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect(); if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--version" || a == "-V") { println!("Lattice {}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")); return Ok(()); } let mut control_port: Option<u16> = std::env::var("LATTICE_CONTROL_PORT").ok().and_then(|p| p.parse().ok()); let mut sample: Option<String> = None; let mut files: Vec<String> = Vec::new(); let mut i = 0; while i < args.len() { match args[i].as_str() { "--control" => { i += 1; control_port = args.get(i).and_then(|p| p.parse().ok()); } "--sample" => { i += 1; sample = Some(args.get(i).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "sales".into())); } a if a.starts_with("-psn_") => {} a => files.push(a.to_string()), } i += 1; } // The log file lives in the settings folder, next to the preferences; opened after the // arguments, so `--version` leaves no file behind. Records logged until now are written to it // first. Runs without preferences (agents' test runs) log to standard error only, so they // don't rotate away the user's own logs. if let Some(logger) = logger { match log_dir().filter(|_| prefs_enabled()) { Some(dir) => match logger.attach_dir(&dir) { Ok(path) => log::info!("Lattice {}, log file {}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), path.display()), // Standard error only by now (`attach_dir` gave up on the file); unlike `eprintln!`, never panics. Err(e) => log::warn!("no log file: {e}"), }, None => logger.no_file(), } } let mut session = Session::new(); if let Some(s) = &sample && let Err(e) = session.execute("file.new", json!({"sample": s})) { log::warn!("sample {s}: {e}"); } for f in &files { if let Err(e) = session.execute("file.open", json!({"path": f})) { log::warn!("{f}: {e}"); } } if session.documents().is_empty() { session.new_workbook(); } let mut app = SheetApp::new(session, services()); app.after_engine(); // Show warnings from files opened on the command line. let control_port = control_port; load_prefs(&mut app); let mut viewport = egui::ViewportBuilder::default() .with_title("Lattice") .with_inner_size([1440.0, 900.0]) .with_min_inner_size([640.0, 420.0]) .with_app_id("app.lattice.nimbushq.xyz") .with_drag_and_drop(true); if cfg!(target_os = "macos") { viewport = viewport.with_fullsize_content_view(true).with_titlebar_shown(false).with_title_shown(false); } if let Some(i) = icon() { viewport = viewport.with_icon(i); } let options = eframe::NativeOptions { viewport, ..Default::default() }; // Before eframe creates the wgpu instance: default Windows to DirectX 12 only (see graphics.rs). #[cfg(target_os = "windows")] let options = { let mut options = options; graphics::configure(&mut options, eframe::wgpu::Backends::from_env()); options }; // Registered before the event loop starts, so it catches the Finder event that launched us as // well as later ones. Lives until the event loop returns; the app creator only borrows it. #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] let apple_events = apple_events::AppleEvents::install(); #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] let apple_events = &apple_events; eframe::run_native( "Lattice", options, Box::new(move |cc| { SheetApp::setup_context_for_language(&cc.egui_ctx, app.ui.dark, app.ui.language); if let Some(port) = control_port { match control_server::start(port, cc.egui_ctx.clone()) { Ok(rx) => app.control_rx = Some(rx), Err(e) => log::error!("control channel on port {port}: {e}"), } } Ok(Box::new(App( app, #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] None, #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] apple_events.connect(&cc.egui_ctx), ))) }), ) }

nodes.name: select_theme
nodes.body_text: fn select_theme(app: &mut SheetApp, id: &str) -> bool { let mode = match id { "theme:system" => "system", "theme:light" => "light", "theme:dark" => "dark", _ => return false, }; app.run_or_alert("view.theme", json!({"mode": mode})); true }

nodes.name: install
nodes.body_text: pub fn install(ctx: &egui::Context) -> NativeMenu { let menu = Menu::new(); let app_menu = Submenu::new("Lattice", true); let about = MenuItem::with_id("dialog:about", "About Lattice", true, None); let _ = app_menu.append_items(&[ &about, &PredefinedMenuItem::separator(), &PredefinedMenuItem::services(None), &PredefinedMenuItem::separator(), &PredefinedMenuItem::hide(None), &PredefinedMenuItem::hide_others(None), &PredefinedMenuItem::show_all(None), &PredefinedMenuItem::separator(), &PredefinedMenuItem::quit(None), ]); let _ = menu.append(&app_menu); let mut theme_items = Vec::new(); for (title, entries) in tree() { let sub = Submenu::new(title, true); for (label, id, acc) in entries { if label == "-" { let _ = sub.append(&PredefinedMenuItem::separator()); continue; } if id == "view.theme" { let themes = Submenu::new(label, true); for (mode, label) in [("system", "System"), ("light", "Light"), ("dark", "Dark")] { let item = CheckMenuItem::with_id(format!("theme:{mode}"), label, true, false, None); let _ = themes.append(&item); theme_items.push((mode, item)); } let _ = sub.append(&themes); continue; } let accel = acc.and_then(|a| Accelerator::from_str(a).ok()); let item = MenuItem::with_id(id, label, true, accel); let _ = sub.append(&item); } let _ = menu.append(&sub); } menu.init_for_nsapp(); let (tx, rx) = channel(); let ctx = ctx.clone(); MenuEvent::set_event_handler(Some(move |e: MenuEvent| { let _ = tx.send(e); ctx.request_repaint(); })); NativeMenu { _menu: menu, events: rx, theme_items } }

nodes.name: poll
nodes.signature: pub fn poll(&self, app: &mut SheetApp, ctx: &egui::Context)
nodes.body_text: pub fn poll(&self, app: &mut SheetApp, ctx: &egui::Context) { while let Ok(ev) = self.events.try_recv() { let id = ev.id.as_ref().to_string(); // Text selection belongs to the inline editor, not the worksheet clipboard/undo. if app.text_box_editor.is_some() { let clipboard = match id.as_str() { "edit.copy" => Some(egui::ViewportCommand::RequestCopy), "edit.cut" => Some(egui::ViewportCommand::RequestCut), "edit.paste" => Some(egui::ViewportCommand::RequestPaste), _ => None, }; if let Some(command) = clipboard { ctx.send_viewport_cmd(command); continue; } if id == "edit.undo" || id == "edit.redo" { ctx.input_mut(|i| { i.events.push(egui::Event::Key { key: egui::Key::Z, physical_key: None, pressed: true, repeat: false, modifiers: egui::Modifiers { command: true, mac_cmd: true, shift: id == "edit.redo", ..Default::default() }, }); }); continue; } } if select_theme(app, &id) { continue; } if let Some(url) = id.strip_prefix("url:") { if let Some(open) = &app.services.open_url { open(url); } } else if let Some(rest) = id.strip_prefix("dialog:") { let (name, arg) = rest.split_once(':').unwrap_or((rest, "")); let params: Value = match (name, arg) { ("saveCopy", fmt) => json!({"format": fmt}), ("find", "replace") => json!({"replace": true}), ("note", _) => json!({"threaded": false}), ("comment", _) => json!({"threaded": true}), ("about", tab) => json!({"tab": tab}), _ => json!({}), }; let name = if name == "note" { "comment" } else { name }; app.open_dialog(name, params); } else if id == "edit.copy" || id == "edit.cut" { app.copy_to_clipboard(ctx, &id); } else { app.run_or_alert(&id, json!({})); } } for (mode, item) in &self.theme_items { let checked = app.ui.theme_mode() == *mode; if item.is_checked() != checked { item.set_checked(checked); } } }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: fn main() { let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect(); let get = |k: &str| args.iter().position(|a| a == k).and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1)).cloned(); let server = get("--server").unwrap_or_else(|| "llama-server".into()); let model = get("--model").unwrap_or_default(); let sample = get("--sample").unwrap_or_else(|| "sales".into()); let threads = get("--threads").and_then(|t| t.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(4); let gpu_layers = get("--gpu-layers").and_then(|t| t.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0); let think = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--think"); let request = args.last().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "Bold the header row.".into()); // `--dump-prompt`: print the first prompt the app would send (for runtime benchmarks) and exit, no runtime needed if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--dump-prompt") { let mut host = lattice_mcp::Headless::new(); if let Err(e) = lattice_assistant::ToolHost::call(&mut host, "new_workbook", &json!({"sample": sample})) { eprintln!("sample: {e}"); } let h = Harness::default(); let messages = [system_message(), user_message(&h.snapshot(&mut host), &request)]; print!("{}", render(&messages, think, true)); return; } let t0 = Instant::now(); let cfg = RuntimeConfig { server: server.into(), model: model.into(), ctx_size: 16384, threads, gpu_layers, port: lattice_assistant::install::free_port().unwrap_or(18080), }; let srv = match LlamaServer::spawn(&cfg, Duration::from_secs(300)) { Ok(s) => Arc::new(s), Err(e) => { eprintln!("runtime: {e}"); std::process::exit(1); } }; println!("load_s {:.2}", t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64()); let mut host = lattice_mcp::Headless::new(); if let Err(e) = lattice_assistant::ToolHost::call(&mut host, "new_workbook", &json!({"sample": sample})) { eprintln!("sample: {e}"); } let h = Harness::default(); let generator: Arc<dyn Generator> = srv.clone(); let t1 = Instant::now(); let mut run = Run::start(generator, &h, &mut host, &request, think); let mut last = Instant::now(); let mut first_text: Option<f64> = None; loop { for ev in run.poll(&h, &mut host) { match ev { Event::Text(_) => { first_text.get_or_insert(t1.elapsed().as_secs_f64()); } Event::ToolFinished { name, observation } => { println!("tool {:>6.2}s {name}: {}", last.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), observation.lines().next().unwrap_or("")); last = Instant::now(); } Event::NeedsConfirmation { .. } => run.confirm(false), Event::Answer(a) => println!("answer {:>6.2}s {a}", last.elapsed().as_secs_f64()), Event::Failed(e) => println!("failed {e}"), Event::ToolStarted { .. } => {} } } if run.is_finished() { break; } std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20)); } println!( "total_s {:.2} first_token_s {:.2} prompt_tokens {} generated_tokens {}", t1.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), first_text.unwrap_or(-1.0), run.tokens_in, run.tokens_out ); }

Text(String), ToolStarted { name: String, args: Value, }, ToolFinished { name: String, observation: String, }, /// A risky call is waiting for the user; answer with [`Run::confirm`]. NeedsConfirmation { name: String, args: Value, }, Answer(String), Failed(String), }

nodes.name: Worker
nodes.body_text: enum Worker { Text(String), Done(Result<GenOutput, String>), }

nodes.name: State
nodes.body_text: enum State { Generating(Receiver<Worker>), Executing, AwaitingConfirmation, Finished, }

nodes.name: Run
nodes.body_text: pub struct Run { generator: Arc<dyn Generator>, pub messages: Vec<Value>, pub thinking: bool, state: State, stop: Arc<AtomicBool>, pending: VecDeque<ToolCall>, decision: Option<bool>, next_call_id: usize, steps: usize, pub tokens_in: u64, pub tokens_out: u64, }

nodes.name: start
nodes.signature: pub fn start(generator: Arc<dyn Generator>, harness: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost, request: &str, thinking: bool) -> Run
nodes.body_text: pub fn start(generator: Arc<dyn Generator>, harness: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost, request: &str, thinking: bool) -> Run { let messages = vec![system_message(), user_message(&harness.snapshot(host), request)]; let mut run = Run { generator, messages, thinking, state: State::Finished, stop: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)), pending: VecDeque::new(), decision: None, next_call_id: 0, steps: 0, tokens_in: 0, tokens_out: 0, }; run.generate(); run }

nodes.name: params
nodes.body_text: fn params(&self) -> GenParams { GenParams { max_tokens: if self.thinking { 4096 } else { 1536 }, ..GenParams::default() } }

nodes.name: generate
nodes.body_text: fn generate(&mut self) { self.steps += 1; let prompt = render(&self.messages, self.thinking, true); let (tx, rx) = channel(); let generator = Arc::clone(&self.generator); let stop = Arc::clone(&self.stop); let params = self.params(); std::thread::spawn(move || { let r = generator.generate(&prompt, &params, &mut |t| { let _ = tx.send(Worker::Text(t.to_string())); !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) }); let _ = tx.send(Worker::Done(r)); }); self.state = State::Generating(rx); }

nodes.name: is_finished
nodes.body_text: pub fn is_finished(&self) -> bool { matches!(self.state, State::Finished) }

nodes.name: is_waiting_for_user
nodes.body_text: pub fn is_waiting_for_user(&self) -> bool { matches!(self.state, State::AwaitingConfirmation) }

nodes.name: cancel
nodes.body_text: pub fn cancel(&mut self) { self.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed); self.pending.clear(); self.state = State::Finished; }

nodes.name: confirm
nodes.signature: pub fn confirm(&mut self, yes: bool)
nodes.body_text: pub fn confirm(&mut self, yes: bool) { if matches!(self.state, State::AwaitingConfirmation) { self.decision = Some(yes); self.state = State::Executing; } }

nodes.name: poll
nodes.signature: pub fn poll(&mut self, harness: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost) -> Vec<Event>
nodes.body_text: pub fn poll(&mut self, harness: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost) -> Vec<Event> { let mut events = Vec::new(); if let State::Generating(rx) = &self.state { let mut done = None; loop { match rx.try_recv() { Ok(Worker::Text(t)) => events.push(Event::Text(t)), Ok(Worker::Done(r)) => { done = Some(r); break; } Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => break, Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => { done = Some(Err("the assistant runtime stopped unexpectedly".into())); break; } } } match done { None => return events, Some(Err(e)) => { self.state = State::Finished; events.push(Event::Failed(e)); return events; } Some(Ok(out)) => self.on_generated(out, &mut events), } } if matches!(self.state, State::Executing) { self.execute(harness, host, &mut events); } events }

nodes.name: on_generated
nodes.signature: fn on_generated(&mut self, out: GenOutput, events: &mut Vec<Event>)
nodes.body_text: fn on_generated(&mut self, out: GenOutput, events: &mut Vec<Event>) { self.tokens_in += out.prompt_tokens; self.tokens_out += out.generated_tokens; let (thought, after, closed) = if self.thinking { split_thinking(&out.text) } else { (String::new(), out.text.clone(), true) }; let calls = if closed { parse_tool_calls(if self.thinking { &after } else { &out.text }) } else { Vec::new() }; if calls.is_empty() || self.stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { let (_, fin, _) = split_thinking(&out.text); let mut msg = json!({"role": "assistant", "content": fin}); if !thought.is_empty() { msg["reasoning_content"] = Value::String(thought); } self.messages.push(msg); self.state = State::Finished; events.push(if fin.is_empty() && out.truncated { Event::Failed("the answer was cut off; try a narrower request".into()) } else { Event::Answer(if fin.is_empty() { "Done.".into() } else { fin }) }); return; } let calls: Vec<ToolCall> = calls.into_iter().take(MAX_CALLS_PER_TURN).collect(); let tool_calls: Vec<Value> = calls .iter() .enumerate() .map(|(k, c)| json!({"id": format!("call_{}", self.next_call_id + k), "type": "function", "function": {"name": c.name, "arguments": c.arguments}})) .collect(); let mut msg = json!({"role": "assistant", "content": "", "tool_calls": tool_calls}); if !thought.is_empty() { msg["reasoning_content"] = Value::String(thought); } self.messages.push(msg); self.pending = calls.into(); self.state = State::Executing; }

nodes.name: execute
nodes.signature: fn execute(&mut self, harness: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost, events: &mut Vec<Event>)
nodes.body_text: fn execute(&mut self, harness: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost, events: &mut Vec<Event>) { while let Some(call) = self.pending.front().cloned() { if is_risky(&call.name, &call.arguments) && self.decision.is_none() { self.state = State::AwaitingConfirmation; events.push(Event::NeedsConfirmation { name: call.name, args: call.arguments }); return; } let decision = self.decision.take().unwrap_or(true); self.pending.pop_front(); events.push(Event::ToolStarted { name: call.name.clone(), args: call.arguments.clone() }); let observation = harness.run(host, &call.name, &call.arguments, &mut |_, _| decision); self.messages .push(json!({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": format!("call_{}", self.next_call_id), "name": call.name, "content": observation})); self.next_call_id += 1; events.push(Event::ToolFinished { name: call.name, observation }); } if self.steps >= MAX_STEPS { self.state = State::Finished; events.push(Event::Failed(format!("stopped after {MAX_STEPS} steps; the changes so far are kept (Undo removes them)"))); return; } self.generate(); }

nodes.body_text: mod tests { use super::*; use std::sync::Mutex; /// Replays scripted model outputs. struct Script(Mutex<VecDeque<String>>); impl Generator for Script { fn generate(&self, _: &str, _: &GenParams, on_text: &mut dyn FnMut(&str) -> bool) -> Result<GenOutput, String> { let text = self.0.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.pop_front().ok_or("script exhausted")?; on_text(&text); Ok(GenOutput { text, truncated: false, prompt_tokens: 10, generated_tokens: 5 }) } } fn run_to_end(run: &mut Run, h: &Harness, host: &mut dyn ToolHost, confirm: Option<bool>) -> Vec<Event> { let mut all = Vec::new(); for _ in 0..2000 { let ev = run.poll(h, host); if ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, Event::NeedsConfirmation { .. })) { run.confirm(confirm.unwrap_or(false)); } all.extend(ev); if run.is_finished() { break; } std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(2)); } all } #[test] fn runs_tool_calls_and_answers() { let script = Script(Mutex::new(VecDeque::from([ "<|tool_call>call:set_cell{cell:<|\"|>D2<|\"|>,input:<|\"|>=B2*2<|\"|>}<tool_call|>".to_string(), "Put =B2*2 in D2.".to_string(), ]))); let mut host = lattice_mcp::Headless::new(); let h = Harness::default(); let mut run = Run::start(Arc::new(script), &h, &mut host, "Double B2 into D2", false); let ev = run_to_end(&mut run, &h, &mut host, None); assert!(ev.contains(&Event::Answer("Put =B2*2 in D2.".into())), "{ev:?}"); assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, Event::ToolFinished { observation, .. } if observation.starts_with("OK")))); assert_eq!(host.session.execute("cell.get", json!({"cell": "D2"})).unwrap()["formula"], "=B2*2"); assert_eq!(run.messages.len(), 5, "system, user, call, tool, answer"); } #[test] fn risky_calls_wait_for_the_user() { let script = Script(Mutex::new(VecDeque::from([ "<|tool_call>call:execute_command{command:<|\"|>file.new<|\"|>}<tool_call|>".to_string(), "Okay, I left your workbook open.".to_string(), ]))); let mut host = lattice_mcp::Headless::new(); let h = Harness::default(); let mut run = Run::start(Arc::new(script), &h, &mut host, "new workbook", false); let ev = run_to_end(&mut run, &h, &mut host, Some(false)); assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, Event::NeedsConfirmation { .. }))); assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, Event::ToolFinished { observation, .. } if observation.starts_with("DECLINED")))); } #[test] fn step_limit_and_runtime_errors_end_the_run() { let looping = Script(Mutex::new((0..20).map(|_| "<|tool_call>call:inspect_workbook{}<tool_call|>".to_string()).collect())); let mut host = lattice_mcp::Headless::new(); let h = Harness::default(); let mut run = Run::start(Arc::new(looping), &h, &mut host, "loop", false); let ev = run_to_end(&mut run, &h, &mut host, None); assert!(matches!(ev.last(), Some(Event::Failed(m)) if m.contains("stopped after")), "{:?}", ev.last()); let empty = Script(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new())); let mut run = Run::start(Arc::new(empty), &h, &mut host, "x", false); let ev = run_to_end(&mut run, &h, &mut host, None); assert!(matches!(ev.last(), Some(Event::Failed(_)))); } }

nodes.body_text: pub fn format_argument(v: &Value, escape_keys: bool) -> String { match v { Value::Null => "null".into(), Value::String(s) => format!("<|\"|>{s}<|\"|>"), Value::Bool(b) => if *b { "true" } else { "false" }.into(), Value::Object(o) => { let parts: Vec<String> = dictsort(o) .into_iter() .map(|(k, x)| format!("{}:{}", if escape_keys { format!("<|\"|>{k}<|\"|>") } else { k.clone() }, format_argument(x, escape_keys))) .collect(); format!("{{{}}}", parts.join(",")) } Value::Array(a) => format!("[{}]", a.iter().map(|x| format_argument(x, escape_keys)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")), Value::Number(_) => py_str(v), } }

nodes.signature: pub fn render(messages: &[Value], enable_thinking: bool, add_generation_prompt: bool) -> String
nodes.body_text:
pub fn render(messages: &[Value], enable_thinking: bool, add_generation_prompt: bool) -> String { let mut out = String::from(BOS); let mut prev = Prev::None; let mut loop_messages = messages; let first_is_system = messages.first().is_some_and(|m| matches!(role(m), "system" | "developer")); if enable_thinking || first_is_system { out.push_str("<|turn>system
"); if enable_thinking { out.push_str("<|think|>
"); prev = Prev::Think; } if first_is_system { if let Some(m) = messages.first() { match m.get("content") { Some(Value::String(s)) => out.push_str(s.trim()), Some(Value::Array(items)) => { for i in items { out.push_str(i.get("text").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("").trim()); out.push(' '); } } _ => {} } } loop_messages = messages.get(1..).unwrap_or(&[]); } out.push_str("<turn|>
"); } let last_user = loop_messages.iter().rposition(|m| role(m) == "user").map_or(-1, |i| i as i64); let mut prev_non_tool_role: Option<&str> = None; for (idx, m) in loop_messages.iter().enumerate() { if role(m) == "tool" { continue; } prev = Prev::None; let r = if role(m) == "assistant" { "model" } else { role(m) }; let continue_same = r == "model" && prev_non_tool_role == Some("assistant"); if !continue_same { out.push_str("<|turn>"); out.push_str(r); out.push('
'); } let thinking = [m.get("reasoning"), m.get("reasoning_content")].into_iter().flatten().find_map(|t| t.as_str().filter(|s| !s.is_empty())); if let Some(t) = thinking && (idx as i64) > last_user { out.push_str("<|channel>thought
"); out.push_str(t); out.push_str("
<channel|>"); } let calls = m.get("tool_calls").and_then(Value::as_array).filter(|c| !c.is_empty()); if let Some(calls) = calls { for tc in calls { let f = tc.get("function").unwrap_or(&Value::Null); out.push_str("<|tool_call>call:"); out.push_str(f.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("")); out.push('{'); if let Some(args) = f.get("arguments").and_then(Value::as_object) { let parts: Vec<String> = dictsort(args).into_iter().map(|(k, v)| format!("{k}:{}", format_argument(v, false))).collect(); out.push_str(&parts.join(",")); } out.push_str("}<tool_call|>"); } prev = Prev::ToolCall; } let mut tr_out = false; if let Some(calls) = calls { for follow in loop_messages.iter().skip(idx + 1).take_while(|f| role(f) == "tool") { let mut name = follow.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).unwrap_or("unknown").to_string(); for tc in calls { if tc.get("id").is_some() && tc.get("id") == follow.get("tool_call_id") { name = tc.get("function").and_then(|f| f.get("name")).and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("").to_string(); } } let body = match follow.get("content") { Some(Value::Array(parts)) => Value::String( parts .iter() .filter(|p| p.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("text")) .map(|p| p.get("text").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("")) .collect(), ), Some(v) => v.clone(), None => Value::Null, }; out.push_str(&tool_response_block(&name, &body)); tr_out = true; prev = Prev::ToolResponse; } } let captured = content_text(m, r == "model"); out.push_str(&captured); let has_content = !captured.trim().is_empty(); let next_nt = loop_messages.iter().skip(idx + 1).find(|x| role(x) != "tool").map(role); let continues_into_next = r == "model" && next_nt == Some("assistant") && (calls.is_none() || tr_out); if prev == Prev::ToolCall && !tr_out { out.push_str("<|tool_response>"); } else if continues_into_next { } else if !(tr_out && !has_content && next_nt.is_none()) { out.push_str("<turn|>
"); } prev_non_tool_role = Some(role(m)); } if add_generation_prompt { if prev != Prev::ToolResponse && prev != Prev::ToolCall { out.push_str("<|turn>model
"); } else if prev == Prev::ToolResponse && enable_thinking { out.push_str("<|channel>thought
"); } } out }

nodes.body_text: pub fn tokens(text: &str) -> Vec<String> { let lower = text.to_lowercase(); let mut out = Vec::new(); let mut cur = String::new(); let flush = |cur: &mut String, out: &mut Vec<String>| { let t = cur.trim_matches(|c| matches!(c, '.' | '-' | '_')); if t.chars().count() > 1 { out.push(t.to_string()); } cur.clear(); }; for c in lower.chars() { let alnum = c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit(); if alnum || (!cur.is_empty() && matches!(c, '.' | '_' | '-')) { cur.push(c); } else if !cur.is_empty() { flush(&mut cur, &mut out); } } if !cur.is_empty() { flush(&mut cur, &mut out); } out }

nodes.signature: pub fn search(&self, query: &str) -> Vec<&(String, String)>
nodes.body_text: pub fn search(&self, query: &str) -> Vec<&(String, String)> { let (k1, b) = (1.2_f64, 0.75_f64); let q = tokens(query); let n = self.chunks.len() as f64; let mut scored: Vec<(f64, usize)> = Vec::new(); for (i, ts) in self.toks.iter().enumerate() { let mut tf: HashMap<&str, f64> = HashMap::new(); for w in ts { *tf.entry(w.as_str()).or_insert(0.0) += 1.0; } let mut s = 0.0; for w in &q { if let Some(&f) = tf.get(w.as_str()) { let d = *self.df.get(w).unwrap_or(&0) as f64; let idf = (1.0 + (n - d + 0.5) / (d + 0.5)).ln(); s += idf * f * (k1 + 1.0) / (f + k1 * (1.0 - b + b * ts.len() as f64 / self.avg)); } } if s > 0.0 { scored.push((s, i)); } } scored.sort_by(|a, c| c.0.total_cmp(&a.0).then(a.1.cmp(&c.1))); scored.into_iter().take(TOP_K).filter_map(|(_, i)| self.chunks.get(i)).collect() }

nodes.body_text: pub fn run(&self, host: &mut dyn ToolHost, name: &str, args: &Value, confirm: &mut dyn FnMut(&str, &Value) -> bool) -> String { let empty = json!({}); let args = if args.is_object() { args } else { &empty }; if name == "lattice_docs" { return self.docs.render(&args.get("search").map(crate::pyfmt::py_str).unwrap_or_default()); } if !TOOL_NAMES.contains(&name) { return render_error(&format!("unknown tool `{name}`")); } if is_risky(name, args) && !confirm(name, args) { let what = if name == "execute_command" { args.get("command").map(crate::pyfmt::py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()) } else { name.to_string() }; return format!("DECLINED: the user did not confirm {what}. Tell them what you would do instead of retrying."); } if name == "write_range" { let n: usize = args.get("values").and_then(Value::as_array).map(|rows| rows.iter().map(|r| r.as_array().map_or(1, Vec::len)).sum()).unwrap_or(0); if n > MAX_CELLS_PER_WRITE { return format!("ERROR: write_range is limited to {MAX_CELLS_PER_WRITE} cells per call; use fill commands for large ranges"); } } if name == "read_range" { let mut a = serde_json::Map::new(); for k in ["range", "sheet"] { if let Some(v) = args.get(k) { a.insert(k.into(), v.clone()); } } let mut f = a.clone(); f.insert("formulas".into(), json!(true)); let mut d = a; d.insert("formatted".into(), json!(true)); return match host.call("read_range", &Value::Object(f)) { Err(e) => render_error(&e), Ok(rf) => render_read(&rf, host.call("read_range", &Value::Object(d)).ok().as_ref()), }; } match host.call(name, args) { Ok(v) => render_result(name, &v), Err(e) => render_error(&e), } }

nodes.name: fmt_scalar
nodes.signature: pub fn fmt_scalar(v: &Value, max_chars: usize) -> String
nodes.body_text: pub fn fmt_scalar(v: &Value, max_chars: usize) -> String { let s = match v { Value::Null => return String::new(), Value::Object(o) if o.contains_key("error") => return o.get("error").map(py_str).unwrap_or_default(), Value::Bool(b) => if *b { "TRUE" } else { "FALSE" }.to_string(), Value::Number(n) if n.as_i64().is_none() && n.as_u64().is_none() => { let f = n.as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0); if f.fract() == 0.0 && f.abs() < 1e15 { format!("{}", f as i64) } else { float_repr(round6(f)) } } other => py_str(other), }; truncate(&s.replace('\n', " ").replace('|', "/"), max_chars) }

nodes.name: col_letter
nodes.signature: pub fn col_letter(mut n: u32) -> String
nodes.body_text: pub fn col_letter(mut n: u32) -> String { let mut s = Vec::new(); while n > 0 { let r = (n - 1) % 26; n = (n - 1) / 26; s.push(char::from(b'A' + r as u8)); } s.iter().rev().collect() }

nodes.name: split_ref
nodes.body_text: pub fn split_ref(r: &str) -> Option<(u32, u32)> { let r = r.trim(); let letters: String = r.chars().filter(|c| *c != '$').take_while(char::is_ascii_uppercase).collect(); let rest: String = r.chars().filter(|c| *c != '$').skip(letters.len()).collect(); if letters.is_empty() || letters.len() > 3 || rest.is_empty() || !rest.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) { return None; } let col = letters.bytes().fold(0u32, |a, b| a.saturating_mul(26).saturating_add(u32::from(b - b'A' + 1))); Some((col, rest.parse().ok()?)) }

nodes.name: rows_of
nodes.body_text: fn rows_of(v: Option<&Value>) -> Vec<Vec<Value>> { v.and_then(Value::as_array).map(|rows| rows.iter().map(|r| r.as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default()).collect()).unwrap_or_default() }

nodes.name: render_grid
nodes.signature: pub fn render_grid(sheet: &str, top_left: &str, formulas: &[Vec<Value>], values: &[Vec<Value>]) -> String
nodes.body_text: pub fn render_grid(sheet: &str, top_left: &str, formulas: &[Vec<Value>], values: &[Vec<Value>]) -> String { let (c0, r0) = split_ref(top_left).unwrap_or((1, 1)); let widest = formulas.iter().map(Vec::len).max().unwrap_or(0); let ncols = widest.min(MAX_COLS); let rows = &formulas[..formulas.len().min(MAX_ROWS)]; let clipped = formulas.len() > MAX_ROWS || widest > MAX_COLS; let last_col = col_letter(c0 + ncols.max(1) as u32 - 1); let last_row = r0 as usize + rows.len().max(1) - 1; let mut lines = vec![format!("'{sheet}'!{top_left}:{last_col}{last_row}{}", if clipped { " (clipped to 40 rows x 15 columns)" } else { "" })]; let heads: Vec<String> = (0..ncols).map(|j| col_letter(c0 + j as u32)).collect(); lines.push(format!("| row | {} |", heads.join(" | "))); let empty = Vec::new(); for (i, frow) in rows.iter().enumerate() { let vrow = values.get(i).unwrap_or(&empty); let cells: Vec<String> = (0..ncols) .map(|j| { let f = frow.get(j).unwrap_or(&Value::Null); let v = vrow.get(j).unwrap_or(&Value::Null); match f.as_str() { Some(fs) if fs.starts_with('=') => format!("{}→{}", fmt_scalar(f, 60), fmt_scalar(v, 24)), _ => fmt_scalar(if v.is_null() { f } else { v }, 40), } }) .collect(); lines.push(format!("| {} | {} |", r0 as usize + i, cells.join(" | "))); } lines.join("\n") }

nodes.name: render_read
nodes.signature: pub fn render_read(formulas: &Value, formatted: Option<&Value>) -> String
nodes.body_text: pub fn render_read(formulas: &Value, formatted: Option<&Value>) -> String { let rng = formulas.get("range").map(py_str).unwrap_or_default(); let first = rng.split(':').next().unwrap_or(""); let top_left = first.rsplit('!').next().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).unwrap_or("A1"); let sheet = formulas.get("sheet").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or(""); render_grid(sheet, top_left, &rows_of(formulas.get("values")), &rows_of(formatted.and_then(|f| f.get("values")))) }

nodes.name: truthy
nodes.body_text: fn truthy(v: Option<&Value>) -> bool { match v { None | Some(Value::Null) => false, Some(Value::Bool(b)) => *b, Some(Value::Number(n)) => n.as_f64().is_some_and(|f| f != 0.0), Some(Value::String(s)) => !s.is_empty(), Some(Value::Array(a)) => !a.is_empty(), Some(Value::Object(o)) => !o.is_empty(), } }

nodes.name: style_summary
nodes.body_text: pub fn style_summary(st: &Value) -> String { let mut out = Vec::new(); let font = st.get("font").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null); let mut bits: Vec<String> = ["bold", "italic", "strike"].iter().filter(|k| truthy(font.get(**k))).map(|k| k.to_string()).collect(); if !matches!(font.get("underline").and_then(Value::as_str), None | Some("None")) { bits.push("underline".into()); } let name = font.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str); let size = font.get("size").and_then(Value::as_f64); if let Some(n) = name && !n.is_empty() && (n != "Calibri" || size != Some(11.0)) { bits.push(format!("{n} {}", fmt_scalar(font.get("size").unwrap_or(&Value::Null), 40))); } if let Some(c) = font.get("color").and_then(color) { bits.push(format!("color {c}")); } if !bits.is_empty() { out.push(format!("font {}", bits.join(" "))); } let fill = st.get("fill").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null); if !matches!(fill.get("pattern").and_then(Value::as_str), None | Some("None")) && let Some(c) = fill.get("fg").and_then(color) { out.push(format!("fill {c}")); } let nf = st.get("num_fmt").filter(|v| truthy(Some(v))).or_else(|| st.get("numFmt")); if let Some(nf) = nf.filter(|v| truthy(Some(v)) && v.as_str() != Some("General")) { out.push(format!("format {}", json_dumps(nf, false))); } let al = st.get("align").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null); if let Some(h) = al.get("h").filter(|h| !h.is_null() && h.as_str() != Some("General")) { out.push(format!("align {}", py_str(h).to_lowercase())); } if truthy(al.get("wrap")) { out.push("wrap".into()); } let mut edges: Vec<String> = st .get("borders") .and_then(Value::as_object) .map(|b| { b.iter() .filter(|(_, line)| line.is_object() && !matches!(line.get("style").and_then(Value::as_str), None | Some("None"))) .map(|(e, _)| e.clone()) .collect() }) .unwrap_or_default(); if !edges.is_empty() { edges.sort(); out.push(format!("borders {}", edges.join(","))); } out.join("; ") }

nodes.name: render_cell
nodes.body_text: pub fn render_cell(r: &Value) -> String { let mut parts = Vec::new(); if truthy(r.get("formula")) { parts.push(format!("formula {}", py_str(&r["formula"]))); } let value = r.get("value").unwrap_or(&Value::Null); let shown = fmt_scalar(value, 80); parts.push(format!("value {}", if shown.is_empty() { "(empty)".to_string() } else { shown })); if let Some(d) = r.get("display") && !d.is_null() && d.as_str() != Some("") && py_str(d) != fmt_scalar(value, 40) { parts.push(format!("shows {}", json_dumps(d, false))); } for k in ["spill", "spilledFrom", "merge", "comment", "hyperlink"] { if let Some(v) = r.get(k).filter(|v| truthy(Some(v))) { let text = if v.is_object() { Value::String(json_dumps(v, false)) } else { v.clone() }; parts.push(format!("{k} {}", fmt_scalar(&text, 80))); } } let st = style_summary(r.get("style").unwrap_or(&Value::Null)); if !st.is_empty() { parts.push(format!("style {st}")); } format!("{}: {}", r.get("cell").map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()), parts.join(" | ")) }

nodes.name: render_workbook
nodes.signature: pub fn render_workbook(w: &Value, undo: bool) -> String
nodes.body_text: pub fn render_workbook(w: &Value, undo: bool) -> String { let empty = Vec::new(); let sheets = w.get("sheets").and_then(Value::as_array).unwrap_or(&empty); let active_i = w.get("activeSheet").and_then(Value::as_u64).unwrap_or(0) as usize; let active = sheets.get(active_i).and_then(|s| s.get("name")).map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "?".into()); let title = [w.get("title"), w.get("path")].into_iter().flatten().find(|v| truthy(Some(v))).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::String("untitled".into())); let get = |k: &str| w.get(k).map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()); let calc = w.get("calcMode").filter(|c| !c.is_null() && c.as_str() != Some("Automatic")); let mut lines = vec![format!( "Workbook {}{} · active sheet '{active}' · selection {} (active cell {}){}", json_dumps(&title, false), if truthy(w.get("dirty")) { " (unsaved changes)" } else { "" }, get("selection"), get("activeCell"), calc.map(|c| format!(" · calc {}", py_str(c))).unwrap_or_default() )]; for s in sheets { let sget = |k: &str| s.get(k).map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()); let used = s.get("usedRange").filter(|v| truthy(Some(v))).map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "(empty)".into()); let mut bits = vec![format!("- '{}' used {used}", sget("name"))]; if let Some(v) = s.get("visibility").filter(|v| !v.is_null() && v.as_str() != Some("Visible")) { bits.push(py_str(v).to_lowercase()); } for t in s.get("tables").and_then(Value::as_array).unwrap_or(&empty) { let cols: Vec<String> = t.get("columns").and_then(Value::as_array).unwrap_or(&empty).iter().map(py_str).collect(); let tget = |k: &str| t.get(k).map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()); bits.push(format!("table {} {} [{}]", tget("name"), tget("range"), cols.join(", "))); } let charts: Vec<String> = s .get("charts") .and_then(Value::as_array) .unwrap_or(&empty) .iter() .map(|c| { let title = c.get("title").filter(|v| truthy(Some(v))).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::String(String::new())); format!( "#{} {} {} at {}", c.get("id").map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()), c.get("kind").map(py_str).unwrap_or_default().to_lowercase(), json_dumps(&title, false), c.get("at").map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()) ) }) .collect(); if !charts.is_empty() { bits.push(format!("charts: {}", charts.join(", "))); } if truthy(s.get("autofilter")) { bits.push(format!("autofilter {}", sget("autofilter"))); } if let Some(fr) = s.get("freeze").and_then(Value::as_array) && fr.len() == 2 && fr.iter().any(|x| truthy(Some(x))) { bits.push(format!("frozen {} rows, {} columns", py_str(&fr[0]), py_str(&fr[1]))); } for (k, label) in [ ("conditionalFormats", "conditional formats"), ("validations", "validations"), ("comments", "comments"), ("images", "images"), ("shapes", "shapes"), ] { if truthy(s.get(k)) { bits.push(format!("{label} {}", sget(k))); } } if let Some(m) = s.get("merges").and_then(Value::as_array).filter(|m| !m.is_empty()) { bits.push(format!("merged {}", m.iter().take(6).map(py_str).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "))); } if truthy(s.get("protected")) { bits.push("protected".into()); } lines.push(bits.join(" · ")); } if let Some(names) = w.get("names").and_then(Value::as_array).filter(|n| !n.is_empty()) { let shown: Vec<String> = names .iter() .take(12) .map(|n| match n { Value::Object(o) => format!( "{}={}", o.get("name").map(py_str).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".into()), o.get("refersTo").or_else(|| o.get("formula")).map(py_str).unwrap_or_default() ), other => py_str(other), }) .collect(); lines.push(format!("Names: {}", shown.join(", "))); } if undo && let Some(u) = w.get("undo").and_then(Value::as_array).filter(|u| !u.is_empty()) { let tail: Vec<String> = u.iter().skip(u.len().saturating_sub(4)).map(py_str).collect(); lines.push(format!("Undo history (latest last): {}", tail.join(", "))); } lines.join("\n") }

nodes.body_text: fn render_list(rows: &[Value], line: impl Fn(&Value) -> String, none: &str) -> String { if rows.is_empty() { return none.to_string(); } let mut out: Vec<String> = rows.iter().take(MAX_LIST).map(line).collect(); if rows.len() > MAX_LIST { out.push(format!("(+{} more; narrow the search)", rows.len() - MAX_LIST)); } out.join("\n") }

nodes.name: parse_value
nodes.signature: fn parse_value(c: &mut Cursor, depth: usize) -> Result<Value, ()>
nodes.body_text: fn parse_value(c: &mut Cursor, depth: usize) -> Result<Value, ()> { if depth > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(()); } c.skip_ws(); if c.starts(Q) { c.i += Q.len(); let end = c.rest().find(Q).ok_or(())?; let v = c.rest().get(..end).unwrap_or("").to_string(); c.i += end + Q.len(); return Ok(Value::String(v)); } match c.peek() { Some('"') => { c.bump(); let mut buf = String::new(); loop { match c.peek() { None => break, Some('"') => { c.bump(); break; } Some('\\') => { c.bump(); match c.peek() { Some('n') => buf.push('\n'), Some('t') => buf.push('\t'), Some(x) => buf.push(x), None => buf.push('\\'), } c.bump(); } Some(x) => { buf.push(x); c.bump(); } } } Ok(Value::String(buf)) } Some('{') => { c.bump(); parse_object(c, depth + 1) } Some('[') => { c.bump(); let mut out = Vec::new(); loop { c.skip_ws(); match c.peek() { None => return Err(()), Some(']') => { c.bump(); return Ok(Value::Array(out)); } _ => {} } out.push(parse_value(c, depth + 1)?); c.skip_ws(); match c.peek() { Some(',') => c.bump(), Some(']') | None => {} Some(_) => return Err(()), } } } _ => { let start = c.i; while !matches!(c.peek(), None | Some(',' | '}' | ']')) { c.bump(); } if c.i == start { return Err(()); } let raw = c.s.get(start..c.i).unwrap_or("").trim(); Ok(scalar(raw)) } } }

nodes.name: scalar
nodes.body_text: fn scalar(raw: &str) -> Value { match raw { "true" => return Value::Bool(true), "false" => return Value::Bool(false), "null" => return Value::Null, _ => {} } let int_like = !raw.is_empty() && raw.strip_prefix('-').unwrap_or(raw).chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) && raw != "-"; if int_like && let Ok(i) = raw.parse::<i64>() { return Value::Number(i.into()); } if let Ok(f) = raw.parse::<f64>() && let Some(n) = Number::from_f64(f) { return Value::Number(n); } Value::String(raw.to_string()) }

nodes.name: parse_object
nodes.signature: fn parse_object(c: &mut Cursor, depth: usize) -> Result<Value, ()>
nodes.body_text: fn parse_object(c: &mut Cursor, depth: usize) -> Result<Value, ()> { if depth > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(()); } let mut out = Map::new(); loop { c.skip_ws(); let key = match c.peek() { None => return Err(()), Some('}') => { c.bump(); return Ok(Value::Object(out)); } _ if c.starts(Q) => { c.i += Q.len(); let end = c.rest().find(Q).ok_or(())?; let k = c.rest().get(..end).unwrap_or("").to_string(); c.i += end + Q.len(); k } Some('"') => { c.bump(); let end = c.rest().find('"').ok_or(())?; let k = c.rest().get(..end).unwrap_or("").to_string(); c.i += end + 1; k } _ => { let end = c.rest().find(':').ok_or(())?; let k = c.rest().get(..end).unwrap_or("").trim().to_string(); c.i += end; k } }; c.skip_ws(); if c.peek() == Some(':') { c.bump(); } let v = parse_value(c, depth)?; out.insert(key, v); c.skip_ws(); match c.peek() { Some(',') => c.bump(), Some('}') | None => {} Some(_) => return Err(()), } } }

nodes.name: parse_tool_calls
nodes.body_text: pub fn parse_tool_calls(text: &str) -> Vec<ToolCall> { let Ok(re) = regex::Regex::new(r"<\|tool_call>\s*call:\s*([A-Za-z_][\w\-.]*)\s*\{") else { return Vec::new() }; re.captures_iter(text) .filter_map(|cap| { let m = cap.get(0)?; let mut c = Cursor { s: text, i: m.end() }; let args = parse_object(&mut c, 0).ok()?; Some(ToolCall { name: cap.get(1)?.as_str().to_string(), arguments: args }) }) .collect() }
